entities.name: Azlan Shah I of Perak
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Azlan Muhibbuddin Shah ibni Almarhum Sultan Yussuff Izzuddin Shah Ghafarullahu-lah was Sultan of Perak from 1984 until his death in 2014, the ninth Yang di-Pertuan Agong, from 1989 to 1994, and the 5th Lord President of the Supreme Court, from 1982 to 1984.
